title: 第19章 十六岁的超凡境第20章 以一敌二崭露锋芒
slug: 开局长生不死谁都以为我无敌
lines: 第19章十六岁的超凡境？此话一出，原本热闹的氛围，突然之间鸦雀无声。
这是什么场合？
怎么会有人敢这种时候出言不逊？
陈家？哪一个陈家？
不少人第一时间都没有反应过来，都是一脸懵逼，摸不着头脑。
然而当听到陈家这两个字的时候，柳家众人都是心头一震。
来了！
他们陈家的人竟然真的来了？
柳家家主向着三长老看了过去，发现三长老此时的脸色也并不好看，很显然他也没有料到会出现意外。
大周国国主倒是淡定许多，似乎对于这样的情况，也在意料之中。
“放肆！”
“何人胆敢出言不逊？”
“可知道今天是什么场合？轮得到你们说话吗？”大太监连忙站出来怒斥了一声。
“我若是不来。”
“那柳家大小姐，又如何恢复清白自由之身呢？”
陈云轩的一句话，可以说是引起了轩然大波，清白自由之身？
这里面可太有内容了，难不成，这柳家大小姐之前，就已经……
“胡说八道！”
“究竟是何人，有种站出来。”五皇子脸上充满了愤怒。
众目睽睽之下，这句话不管是真是假，对柳梦妍的影响都极大，对他同样也有影响。
日后免不了要被别人在背后议论个不停。
谁也不在乎真假，内容有趣才是他们所关心的。
陈云轩身影一闪，从人群之中来到了台前。
看到陈云轩的年龄，众人都是一愣，一个人，还这么年轻？他这是不想活了吗？
“陈云轩，居然是你。”
“你为何要出言侮辱我？”柳梦妍看到陈云轩，眼神之中充满了愤怒。
“怎么？我说的有错吗？”
“你柳家和我陈家的契约，你不会这么快就忘了吧？”
“你柳梦妍，身为家主之女，按照契约，是要嫁入我陈家的人。”
“如今你和其他男子订婚，这算什么？”
“不守妇道？”
“背信弃义？”
“若非如此，你当日又何必前往我陈家，索要当年的契约？”陈云轩冷笑着说道。
“陈家，原来是那个陈家，我竟然都快要忘了这件事情那个。”
content_en:
Chapter 19 The extraordinary state at the age of sixteen? As soon as these words came out, the originally lively atmosphere suddenly fell into silence.
What is the occasion?
How could anyone dare to be rude at this time?
Chen family? Which Chen family?
Many people didn't react at the first time, they were all confused and confused.
However, when they heard the words Chen family, everyone in the Liu family was shocked.
Coming!
People from the Chen family are actually here?
The head of the Liu family looked at the third elder and found that the third elder's face was not good-looking at this time. It was obvious that he did not expect an accident.
The leader of the Great Zhou Kingdom was much calmer, and seemed to have expected this situation.
"Presumptuous!"
"Who dares to say something rude?"
"Do you know what the occasion is today? Is it your turn to speak?" The great eunuch quickly stood up and yelled angrily.
"If I don't come."
"Then how can the eldest lady of the Liu family regain her innocence and freedom?"
Chen Yunxuan's words can be said to have caused an uproar. Innocent and free?
There is so much content here. Could it be possible that the eldest lady of the Liu family has already...
"Nonsense!"
"Who is it that has the guts to come forward?" The fifth prince's face was full of anger.
In front of everyone, whether this sentence is true or not, it has a great impact on Liu Mengyan, and it also has an impact on him.
In the future, you will inevitably be talked about behind your back by others.
No one cares about authenticity, what they care about is interesting content.
Chen Yunxuan's figure flashed and came to the stage from the crowd.
Everyone was stunned when they saw Chen Yunxuan's age. How could a person be so young? Does he not want to live?
"Chen Yunxuan, it's you."
"Why did you insult me?" Liu Mengyan saw Chen Yunxuan, her eyes filled with anger.
"What? Is what I said wrong?"
"You won't forget the contract between your Liu family and my Chen family so quickly, right?"
"You Liu Mengyan, as the daughter of the head of the family, according to the contract, you are the one who will marry into my Chen family."
"Now that you are engaged to another man, what does this mean?"
"Unruly women?"
"Treachery?"
"If not, why did you go to my Chen family that day to ask for the contract?" Chen Yunxuan said with a sneer.
"The Chen family, it turns out to be the Chen family. I almost forgot about this and that."
title_en: Chapter 19: The Extraordinary Realm at the Age of Sixteen Chapter 20: One vs. Two Shows His Edge
